candidates.original_title: Genome-wide association study in esophageal cancer using the genechip mapping 10K array
candidates.description: Genome-wide case-control study identified 38 gene-related SNPs associated with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma risk in Shanxi Province, China
candidates.citation_sentence: To identify genetic factors leading to ESCC susceptibility, we conducted a replication case-control study of 38 gene-related SNPs associated with ESCC in a previous pilot study.
candidates.notes: Authors explicitly state the replication 'confirmed' and 'replicated' the original findings, but only 4 of 38 SNPs replicated their association with ESCC in the replication study. The paper uses numbered references rather than author-date citations, so the citation_sentence does not contain author names and year in the text. A second coder may code this as inconclusive given the partial replication (4/38 SNPs). Paper uses only numeric citations in text; no author-year citation available for the original study. Phase 1 and Phase 2 use the same 300 cases and 300 controls and constitute one study. Authors explicitly state the replication 'confirmed' previously-identified associations.

candidates.original_title: Genome-wide association study in esophageal cancer using the genechip mapping 10K array
candidates.description: The EPHB1 rs1515366 variant was associated with altered risk of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
candidates.citation_sentence: As an initial step in the identification of ESCC susceptibility loci, we performed a whole-genome scan using the Affymetrix 10K SNP array.
candidates.notes: The paper explicitly states that EPHB1/rs1515366 replicated its association with ESCC risk. The citation appears as reference 9 rather than an author-year citation, and no DOI for the original study is provided. [luna56: extra entry, not in the external record]
